EmailClient.__init__:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Initializes an object with the supplied address and capacity, and creates a fresh empty inbox list." __init__]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> addr </REF>: object "The address value to store in self.addr; it is assigned by reference, not copied."
        <REF> capacity </REF>: object "The capacity value to store in self.capacity; it is assigned by reference, not copied."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Store the value of parameter addr in self.addr using a direct reference assignment (no deep copy). RESULT self.addr]
            [COMMAND Store the value of parameter capacity in self.capacity using a direct reference assignment (no deep copy). RESULT self.capacity]
            [COMMAND Create a fresh empty list object and assign it to self.inbox. RESULT self.inbox]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
EmailClient.send_to:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Sends an email to the receiver's inbox if the receiver has enough space for it; otherwise clears the sender's inbox and returns False." send_to]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> self </REF>: object "Sender mailbox instance with addr and clear_inbox(size)."
        <REF> recv </REF>: object "Receiver mailbox instance with addr, inbox, and is_full_with_one_more_email(size)."
        <REF> content </REF>: any "Email content to store in the email."
        <REF> size </REF>: int "Size of the email used for capacity checking."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: boolean "True if the email was appended to the receiver's inbox; False if the receiver was full and the sender's inbox was cleared."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Check whether recv.is_full_with_one_more_email(size) returns False, meaning the receiver has enough room for one more email of the given size. RESULT not_full]
            [COMMAND If not_full is True, generate timestamp using datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"). RESULT timestamp]
            [COMMAND Build email dictionary with sender self.addr, receiver recv.addr, content, size, timestamp, and state 'unread'. RESULT email]
            [COMMAND Append email to recv.inbox. RESULT None]
            [COMMAND Return True. RESULT True]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: recv.is_full_with_one_more_email(size) returns True, meaning the receiver does not have enough room for another email of the given size.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Call self.clear_inbox(size). RESULT None]
            [COMMAND Return False. RESULT False]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
EmailClient.fetch:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Finds and returns the first unread inbox item after marking it as read, or returns None when the inbox is empty or contains no unread items." fetch]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> self </REF>: object "The object whose inbox list is processed."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: object or None "The first unread inbox item after its state is changed to 'read', or None if no such item exists."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Iterate over each index i from 0 to len(self.inbox) - 1 inclusive. RESULT i]
            [COMMAND Within the loop over i, if self.inbox[i]['state'] equals 'unread', set self.inbox[i]['state'] to 'read' and return self.inbox[i]. RESULT first_unread_item]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: The inbox list is empty, so len(self.inbox) == 0.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Return None. RESULT None]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: The loop completes without finding any inbox item whose state is 'unread'.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Return None. RESULT None]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
EmailClient.is_full_with_one_more_email:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Returns whether adding the given size to the current occupied size would make the total strictly exceed the object's capacity." is_full_with_one_more_email]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> size </REF>: int "Number of additional email slots or items to add to the current occupied size."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: bool "True if occupied_size + size is strictly greater than self.capacity; False otherwise."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Retrieve the current occupied size by calling self.get_occupied_size() and assign the returned value to occupied_size. RESULT occupied_size]
            [COMMAND Return True if occupied_size + size is strictly greater than self.capacity; otherwise return False. RESULT return_value]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
EmailClient.get_occupied_size:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Computes the total size of all emails in the inbox by summing the size value of each email." get_occupied_size]
    [INPUTS]
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: integer "The total occupied size of all emails in the inbox."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Initialize occupied_size to 0. RESULT occupied_size]
            [COMMAND For each email in self.inbox, add email['size'] to occupied_size. RESULT occupied_size]
            [COMMAND Return occupied_size. RESULT occupied_size]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
EmailClient.clear_inbox:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Frees space in the inbox by removing emails from the front and summing their sizes until the accumulated space reaches or exceeds the requested size, but returns immediately when the address list is empty." clear_inbox]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> self </REF>: object "Instance containing the address list used by the guard and the inbox list of email dictionaries with a 'size' key."
        <REF> size </REF>: int "Target amount of space to free; the loop stops once freed_space is greater than or equal to size."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: null "Always returns None; the only lasting effect is the in-place mutation of self.inbox."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND After confirming the address list is not empty, initialize freed_space to 0. RESULT freed_space]
            [COMMAND While freed_space is strictly less than size and self.inbox is truthy (non-empty), with short-circuit evaluation, read the first email from self.inbox as email. RESULT email]
            [COMMAND Inside the while loop, add the value of email['size'] to freed_space. RESULT freed_space]
            [COMMAND Inside the same while loop, delete the first element from self.inbox. RESULT self.inbox]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: The address list self.addr is empty.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Return None immediately without clearing the inbox. RESULT None]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
